arguments.body: Hi Luca, this is written notice that HeatRight Ltd (Gas Safe registered) plan to carry out the annual gas safety check at 19 Victoria Park Road on Tuesday 13 October 2026, between 9am and 12pm. If that time doesn't suit, just reply with another time before 16 October and we'll rearrange. We won't enter without your agreement. Thank you.
